pairing_policy: For each repetition and noise level, training, validation, and test trajectories remain separate. Strong FD-LASSO uses the same observed training arrays as the weak methods and selects separate prey and predator penalties on the corresponding independent observed validation arrays.
evaluation_policy: Evaluate every selected strong-form coefficient vector on the same latent held-out trajectory and species-balanced drift metric used by the weak-method sweep.
failure_policy: Retain every prespecified repetition, nonconverged path candidate, boundary selection, nonfinite coefficient, and missing metric.
manuscript_policy: Current manuscript comparison; preserve the declared protocol and independent validation selection.
